name: Modular Block
description: An isometric cube with one corner block cut out and set down beside it. Hard-mitred edges, three flat greys for the three face orientations and nothing else on the page — for modularity, composability and missing-piece stories.

variations.name: default
variations.description: An isometric cube with one corner block cut out and set down beside it — sharp corners, flat shading, nothing else on the page.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the <svg> root. The artwork is viewBox-driven with no width/height attributes, so it fills its container by default.
